_comment: AI radar source catalog. Deliberately small: fewer sources means a smaller triage context and lower token cost per run. Four groups: labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), the people building them, investors, and hardware. Fields: id, name, feed (RSS/Atom; null when the source publishes none - read 'site' with WebFetch instead), site, lang (also decides the card's language), category, weight (1-5). Optional: topic_filter (only items mentioning AI get through), max_items, kind ('release' = version feed), note. Validated against the live network on 2026-09-03. NOTE: X/Twitter has no fetchable feed, so the people here are covered only by their blogs, which are low volume.
